'''Tchochke''' was a trade good during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] traveled to [[Crseih Station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] they encountered beings selling tchochke on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]].
